specimens.title: Rose
specimens.author: Heliona
specimens.changes: Delivered as a compressed derivative (see compression) of the unchanged original in source; runtime topology-derived petal/branch animation, camera and lighting. Mature endpoint bypasses deformation.
specimens.compression: tools/compress-models.mjs: EXT_meshopt_compression without quantization/reordering (vertex attributes byte-identical, triangle order kept, some triangles start from another corner); EXT_texture_webp, small parts downsized

specimens.title: Orchid
specimens.author: Rigsters
specimens.changes: Delivered as a compressed derivative (see compression) of the unchanged original in source; runtime opaque cutout fixes source BLEND sorting artifacts, preserving embedded color/normal/material maps. Branch pose/reveal is not claimed as individual orchid petal animation.
specimens.compression: tools/compress-models.mjs: EXT_meshopt_compression without quantization/reordering (vertex attributes byte-identical, triangle order kept, some triangles start from another corner); EXT_texture_webp, small parts downsized
